hypotheses.S1_frozen_route_is_causal: The FineWeb-discovered frozen-64 route reaches at least 0.10 removal target projection in one FineWeb-selected layer on both evaluation corpora.
hypotheses.S2_frozen_route_recovers_half_oracle: At the FineWeb-selected layer, frozen-64 reaches at least half the absolute oracle-64 removal projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.S3_frozen_heads_beat_shifted_controls: At the FineWeb-selected layer, frozen-64 absolute removal projection is at least twice the median of eight cyclic head-shift controls on both corpora.
hypotheses.S4_larger_frozen_route_adds_effect: At the FineWeb-selected layer, frozen-128 removal target projection is at least frozen-64 on both corpora.
hypotheses.S5_frozen_route_transfers_ood: At the FineWeb-selected layer, TinyStories frozen-64 removal projection retains at least half the FineWeb projection.
hypotheses.S6_frozen_route_is_cross_world_stable: Frozen-64 insertion and removal projections correlate at least 0.70 across records and layers on both corpora.
